meaning_fixes.after: This cannot be allowed to happen!
meaning_fixes.reason: Source 'これは、あってはならないこと！' follows 6509-6510 ('Destroying Upper Earth, of all things!... At this rate, the surface will be doomed!'), which frame the catastrophe as still unfolding, not finished. 'あってはならない' is a present prohibition ('this must not be'), so 'should never have happened' wrongly casts it as a completed event being lamented in hindsight. Reworded to keep the prospective sense (an ongoing disaster the speaker is still trying to stop).
